subject: Beta: Redwood Private upgrade rehearsal + maintenance window (v1.14.0 → v1.15.0)
body:
----- Message 1 of 6 -----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@heliobank.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliobank.com>
Cc: IT Ops <it-ops@heliobank.com>, Change Mgmt <change-mgmt@heliobank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 4:12 PM PST
Subject: Beta: Redwood Private upgrade rehearsal + maintenance window (v1.14.0 → v1.15.0)

Alyssa / Raj,

Following up on the beta upgrade/rollback workstream—thank you again for being willing to run the first customer rehearsal.

Proposal for the maintenance window (your VPC Private deployment):
- Target upgrade: Redwood Private v1.14.0 → v1.15.0 (control plane + runtime + gateways + observability agents)
- Window: Wed Jan 15, 7:00–8:30pm PT (10:00–11:30pm ET)
- Expected service impact: brief gateway restarts; we’ll sequence to minimize downtime, but please assume up to ~10–15 min elevated error rate during the gateway cutover.

Before we lock the window, two quick asks:
1) Please confirm the preferred timezone + that Change Mgmt can approve that window.
2) Can you share who will be on the bridge from HelioBank (ops + app owner)?

I’m attaching the precheck report we pulled against your cluster last week (sanitized), plus a human-readable upgrade plan output so you can see the step ordering.

Attachments:
- heliobank-private-precheck-report_2025-01-13.json
- heliobank-upgrade-plan_v1.15.0.txt

Thanks,
Connor

—
Connor O'Brien
Release Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference


----- Message 2 of 6 -----
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@heliobank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliobank.com>, IT Ops <it-ops@heliobank.com>, Change Mgmt <change-mgmt@heliobank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 7:06 PM ET
Subject: Re: Beta: Redwood Private upgrade rehearsal + maintenance window (v1.14.0 → v1.15.0)

Connor,

Thanks. Wed 10:00–11:30pm ET should be workable, but we need to route through Change Mgmt by tomorrow noon.

Two questions:
1) Can you confirm if rollback is “same-night” if anything fails? We’ll need that in the change record.
2) The precheck report mentions “snapshot permissions” as WARN — is that something we need to fix before Wednesday?

Planned attendees on our side:
- Raj (platform)
- Me
- On-call SRE (TBD)

-Alyssa


----- Message 3 of 6 -----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@heliobank.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliobank.com>
Cc: IT Ops <it-ops@heliobank.com>, Change Mgmt <change-mgmt@heliobank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 4:28 PM PST
Subject: Re: Beta: Redwood Private upgrade rehearsal + maintenance window (v1.14.0 → v1.15.0)

Alyssa,

1) Rollback: yes—our plan is to support a same-night rollback if we fail any of the health gates post-upgrade. Mechanically that means:
   - Re-applying the previous chart versions for gateways + runtime
   - Restoring the control-plane DB snapshot if we cross a migration boundary that’s marked rollback-safe
   - Guardrail: if a migration is marked forward-only, we’ll stop before applying it (precheck/plan should block) rather than get into a “can’t roll back” state.

For Change Mgmt wording you can use:
- “Rollback available within the maintenance window if any post-upgrade validation fails; upgrade runner will halt and offer automatic rollback where safe.”

2) Snapshot permissions WARN: good catch. This is NOT a blocker for the upgrade itself, but it is a blocker for our backup step (and we’re requiring backup verification before we proceed).

Action required (HelioBank):
- Confirm the IAM role used by the installer has permission to create snapshots for the control-plane DB volume (EBS) and describe/list snapshots.

If you can have your cloud ops confirm/adjust by tomorrow morning PT, we should be good.

I’ll also send a short checklist for the bridge (who dials, how we share logs if needed, etc.) once the window is approved.

Thanks,
Connor


----- Message 4 of 6 -----
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliobank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@heliobank.com>, IT Ops <it-ops@heliobank.com>, Change Mgmt <change-mgmt@heliobank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 10:14 AM ET
Subject: Re: Beta: Redwood Private upgrade rehearsal + maintenance window (v1.14.0 → v1.15.0)

Connor,

Understood.

We traced the snapshot permissions WARN to the installer role missing ec2:CreateSnapshot. We can add the minimum set (create + describe + tags) today.

Can you share the exact AWS API actions you expect and if you require KMS permissions? Our EBS volumes are encrypted w/ CMK.

Also: do you need us to pause any internal deployments during the window, or is the gateway restart isolated?

-Raj


----- Message 5 of 6 -----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliobank.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@heliobank.com>
Cc: IT Ops <it-ops@heliobank.com>, Change Mgmt <change-mgmt@heliobank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 8:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: Beta: Redwood Private upgrade rehearsal + maintenance window (v1.14.0 → v1.15.0)

Raj,

Yep—encrypted EBS means we’ll also need the snapshot path to work with your CMK.

Minimum permissions (high-level):
- EC2: CreateSnapshot, DeleteSnapshot (optional; only if you want us to clean up failed attempts), DescribeSnapshots, CreateTags
- KMS: Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/DescribeKey on the CMK used for the volume

If you want, you can restrict EC2 permissions by resource tag (we tag the DB PV and the generated snapshot with “redwood-private=true” and a run id).

On pausing deployments: not required, but we recommend freezing app-side config changes (anything that would update Redwood Private values/config) during the window to reduce drift.

Operationally, the cutover that customers notice is:
- Gateway rollout/restart (traffic impact)
- Control plane restart (API availability blip)

We’ll run a smoke test after each stage (control plane health + gateway routing + a tiny inference request).

If you can confirm the IAM change is in place by EOD today ET, we’re on track.

Connor
